item.title: Ex-special counsel Jack Smith tells lawmakers he stands by Trump charging decisions
item.description: Former special counsel Jack Smith appeared before the Senate Judiciary Committee to defend his two criminal investigations into President Donald Trump.

item.title: Another Trump loyalist helping lead probe into Trump investigations resigns
item.description: Another Trump loyalist assigned to help lead a controversial conspiracy probe targeting President Trump's political opponents has resigned from the DOJ.

item.title: Thune to increase midterm campaign stops as GOP defends Senate majority
item.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune will travel to states with key Senate races in the coming weeks as the GOP fights to retain its majority.

item.title: What to know as Tennessee plans first execution of a woman in 200 years
item.description: Christa Pike is scheduled to die by lethal injection Wednesday in Tennessee. If carried out, she would be the first woman executed in the state in 200 years.
